claim_summaries.claim: The l1 orientation-norm strengthening of coefficient-one square-root exchange fails for an explicit 6x6 integer determinant instance.
claim_summaries.consequence: The associated Renyi-1/2 entropy-lift fails by factor 2, while aggregate l2 square-root exchange is tight in the same fixture.

claim_summaries.claim: The analogous l_p exchange fails on this fixture for every 0 < p < 2.
